title: How to base64 text that survives Unicode and URLs
problem: btoa either throws on emoji or quietly mangles accented text, and the base64 it does produce comes back percent-escaped when it travels in a query parameter.
outcome: Encoding and decoding that round-trips any string, plus a URL-safe form that passes through query parameters and redirects unchanged, from the same API in the browser and in Node.

knowledge: A JavaScript project with a bundler, or a Node.js script
